text:
maya: FYI weve been tracing a recurring delta between billing exports and trace-derived cost for compacted envelopes. Seems like attributes added after compaction (late-enrich) are sometimes missing from the stitch.
ton y: where is compaction happening? ingress compactor before late-enrich join?
elena: yes, compactor reduces attribute set aggressively. late-enrich may add billing.owner and billing.sku which then never make it into the compacted payload.
maya: short-term fix idea: preserve specific keys by name, but that fights our compact goals.
sam: agree. We need a minimal SLO breach. Two ideas: 1) tiny provenance bitset recorded in the compacted envelope to indicate presence of critical keys, 2) a separate "sidecar" record that stores the full late attrs keyed by compact_id for short TTL.
elena: bitset is attractive (4 bytes or so). sidecar gives full fidelity but requires storage+lookup.
ton y: sidecar raises GC and cross-shard lookup complexity. We also need to consider sampled vs unsampled flows: if the trace is sampled out, we have no trace to stitch to.
maya: decision criteria: minimize steady-state envelope size, maintain attribution correctness for top customers, provide graceful fallback and observability.
sam: proposed hybrid: always write bitset into compacted envelope; emit sidecar only for customers above threshold or for requests matched to billing-sensitive routes. Sidecar TTL 10 minutes. Fast lookup via redis index for ~2 minutes, fall back to s3-like longer bucket for rare lookups.
elena: config: maintain a mapping config key->bit index; compactor operates under schema V2 flag (compat fallback). Must tolerate older compactors that lack the bitset.
ton y: rollout: start disabled, enable bitset write on 10% of edge nodes, enable sidecar for 1% heavy-customer traffic. Monitor mismatch metric. ops-bot: deployment scheduled: compactor-v2 -> canary -> 2026-04-10 20:00 UTC
maya: instrumentation: emit cost.attribution.missed counter when stitch fails; emit cost.attribution.fallback when we approximate via route hints. Dashboards: diff between billing export and trace-cost-per-customer.
sam: draft proto sketches: ```message CompactMeta { int64 compact_id = 1; uint32 billing_bitset = 2; int64 ts_ms = 3; } message LateAttrsSidecar { int64 compact_id = 1; map<string,string> attrs = 2; int64 ts_ms = 3; }```
elena: proto ok. Storage plan: write sidecars async to TTL-bucketed object store + index keys to redis/pika for fast windowed lookup. GC: background sweeper deletes old sidecars from index, object store lifecycle policy takes care of long tail.
ton y: security/PII: sidecar must be whitelisted at ingest; run validation to strip any PII keys. Add unit tests to validate whitelist.
maya: edge cases: model-routing changes may mutate billing.sku between request and enrichment. Sidecar should record both pre-enrich hint and post-enrich final sku when available. Bitset only signals presence.
sam: perf: bitset adds small bytes; sidecar write is async and should be negligible for tail latency. We'll need throughput tests to confirm.
elena: compatibility: compactor reads optional billing_bitset field; if missing, treat as zero. Backfill: no.
ton y: analytics/consumer integration: stitcher should do time-window join (compact_id + ts window 5m). If sidecar absent, stitcher emits metric and falls back to approximate attribution.
maya: action items: elena -> compactor PR (bitset+compat tests). sam -> infra task for sidecar storage/index + GC. tony -> define canary monitoring checklist. maya -> dashboard + alert (cost.attribution.missed > 5/min triggers ops). ops-bot: noted and will create pager if threshold exceeded.
maya: thanks everyone. I'll post PR link and dashboard once available; keep the thread for followups.
